MSFT.selection: availability, length and different domains selected before any model score was inspected

Taylor.selection: availability, length and different domains selected before any model score was inspected
Taylor.time_axis: half-hour order; computational 2000-01-01 epoch is artificial, not a claimed original clock alignment

evaluation_contract: All new data and all three seeds required; prior failures are retained; no automatic deployment

excluded_candidates.short_locally_bundled_series: insufficient temporal partition length; no performance inspected

freezing_scope: Local code/protocol commit before any new-series model score; not remotely preregistered
independent_scope: Two datasets, separate training, simulated arrivals; neither universal superiority nor actual cost savings
rules: Keep the original 55/20/10/15 chronological partitions, lookback48,horizon6,stride4.
VAR training uses only transitions fully known by train cutoff; fit arrival survival on a mature training cohort.
Calibrate Gaussian absolute-risk scale using policy labels arrived by policy cutoff; choose only on validation.
ETTh1 is already exposed development data. Never call this an independent confirmation.
All costs, deadlines and original minimum-improvement gates remain unchanged.
Freeze code/config before each complete evaluation. Preserve unsuccessful forced candidate and selected fallback.
Independent new-data evaluation is required before promotion; a passing development gate does not promote.
No outcome-based dataset selection or period trimming.
MSFT uses ordered trading observations, not physical calendar-day delays; preserve real-date mapping.
Taylor uses an explicit artificial epoch for half-hour sequence order.
Cost weights and all numerical gate conditions remain unchanged.
Availability-aware simple strategies are added rather than weakening comparators.
Policy-only uses a Gaussian covariance proxy with a different forecaster; exact Bayes-risk claims do not apply.
Level calibration uses policy partition, selection uses validation only, final results never select candidates.
selection: VAR: minimum validation passive MAE across three decision times; policy: validation objective subject to 1% MAE limit; strong simple always admitted
simple_pool: base/upgraded/value plus all VAR candidates; each instant/half/deadline x none/target/oldest
